in_marathi.name: Pranavidhya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Life Giver, Wise Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranavidhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranavidhya is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'prana' meaning 'life' and 'vidhya' meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. The name signifies a life giver or a wise protector. In Hindu mythology, Pranavidhya is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom.
